name: Branches
description: Branches are raw resources. They are among the most basic resources, used extensively throughout the war. They can also be used as fuel. Fuel duration is 30 seconds.

name: Briar Spruce Log
description: Briar Spruce Log is a raw resource.

name: Briar Spruce Seeds
description: Briar Spruce Seeds are seeds dropped by chopping down Briar Spruce Tree IconResourceWood02.png, which players can plant to grow another briar spruce tree.

name: Cassiterite Fragments
description: Cassiterite Fragments are raw resources.

name: Coal
description: Coal is a large chunk of coal that needs to be smashed before it can be smelted.

name: Crude Resin
description: Crude Resin is a raw resource. Is not stackable.

name: Dead Wood Log

description: Iron Ore Fragment is a raw resource.

name: Limestone

name: North Astrian Pine Seeds

name: Pulverized Coal
description: Pulverized Coal is a raw resource.

name: Rare Metals
description: Rare Metals is a raw resource found in the lowest region in the Underworld. It is used to craft the highest tier of weapons and armour.

name: Rock Slab
description: The Rock Slab is a resource and weapon. As a resource it can be broken down into fragments at the Smashing Plate. As a weapon it can be thrown/dropped onto targets to deal crushing damage.

name: Stone Off-Cuts
description: Stone Off-Cuts are raw resources.

name: Water Bucket
description: Water Buckets are a general purpose resource used by a range of professions. Such as watering Tilled Field , quenching tools at Quenching Station , cooking foods and putting out fires. It can be acquired from a Well or active Canal Storage .

name: Bronze Ingot
description: Bronze Ingot is a manufactured resource. It is used for bronze smithing.

name: Chicken Feed
description: Chicken Feed is an animal feed that can be eaten by Chicken IconChicken.png. Players holding a chicken feed in hands can lure wild chickens.

name: Copper Nails
description: Copper Nails are manufactured resources. They are mainly used for repairing tools, armours and weapons at Repair Bench but also used for crafting certain items and building certain structures.

name: Dead Wood Planks
description: Dead Wood Planks are manufactured resources. Not stackable.

name: Equine Feed
description: Equine Feed is an animal feed that can be eaten by Horse or Donkey . Players holding equine feed in their hands can lure wild horses or donkeys. It restores 50% of an animal's hunger and also provides 0.5% health regeneration for 4 Minutes.

name: Fertilizer
description: Fertilizer is a manufactured resource used on Tilled Field to reduce crop growth time by 33%. Each application of fertilizer lasts for 33 minutes, regardless of the crops planted. It can be applied by equipping fertilizer in hand and clicking while standing on the field. Once applied, the field's surface will display a white ash covering, indicating it is fertilized.

name: Flour
description: Flour is a manufactured resource used for cooking food.

name: Gravel
description: Gravel is a manufactured resource used for building Dirt Path .

name: Iron Ingot
description: Iron Ingot is a manufactured resource. It is used for iron smithing.

name: Lead Ingot
description: Lead Ingot is a manufactured resource. It is one of three trade resources, along with Linen and Rosin .

name: Linen
description: Linen is a manufactured resource. It is one of three trade resources, along with Lead Ingot and Rosin .

name: Mortar
description: Mortar is a manufactured resource.

name: Reinforced Wood Planks
description: Reinforced Wood Planks are manufactured resources. Not stackable

name: Rosin
description: Rosin is a manufactured resource. It is one of three trade resources, along with Lead Ingot and Linen .

name: Sinew Bow String
description: Sinew Bow String is a manufactured resource used for crafting bows.

name: Steel Ingot
description: Steel Ingot is a manufactured resource.

name: Tin Ingot

name: Wood Ash
description: Wood Ash is a byproduct of burning fuel, with each fuel item converting to wood ash at a 1:1 ratio.

name: Wood Blank
description: Wood Blank is a manufactured resource. Not stackable

name: Wood Planks
description: Wood Planks are manufactured resources. They are among the most basic resources, used extensively throughout the war. They can also be used as fuel. Fuel Duration 180 Seconds. Not stackable

name: Animal Bones
description: Animal Bones are resources.

name: Animal Fat
description: Animal Fat is a resource obtained as loot from most animals. It is one of the common resources and used extensively throughout the war.

name: Animal Shite
description: Animal Shite is a resource. It is harvested from Animal Shite Pile . Horse and Donkey produce animal shite while stationed in a Stable .

name: Boar Meat
description: Boar Meat is a raw food used in multiple food recipes. It decays over time and must be cooked before spoiling. Storing it in a Meat Rack IconMeatRack.png extends its shelf life.

name: Chicken Egg
description: A Chicken Egg is a resource that can be collected by having Chicken in proximity to a Hen House . Each morning the chickens will lay 1 each consuming 1 Chicken Feed .

name: Common Meat
description: Common Meat is a raw food used in multiple food recipes, obtained as loot from most animals. It decays over time and must be cooked before spoiling. Storing it in a Meat Rack extends its shelf life.

name: Deer Meat
description: Deer Meat is a raw food used in multiple food recipes. It decays over time and must be cooked before spoiling. Storing it in a Meat Rack extends its shelf life.

name: Feathers
description: Feathers are a resource dropped by Chicken or Dire Raven when killed, or generated by chickens near a Hen House containing Chicken Feed .

name: Cabbage Seed
description: Cabbage Seed is a type of seed that can be planted into a Tilled Field. It can't be planted during winter.

name: Flax

name: Flax Seed
description: Flax Seed is a type of seed that can be planted into a Tilled Field . It can't be planted during winter.

name: Hemp Seed
description: Hemp Seed is a type of seed that can be planted into a Tilled Field . It can be planted only during sumor and lencten.

name: Strong Fibre

name: Wheat Seed

name: Basic Saddle
description: Basic Saddle is a saddle. Before a Horse can be mounted, a basic saddle must be equipped. It also provides 3 stackable slots for item storage.

name: Mill Harness
description: Mill Harness is animal equipment used to attach a Horse or Donkey to a Power Mill .

name: Pack Saddle
description: Pack Saddle is a saddle. It is used on a Donkey IconDonkey.png to transport items. Up to 6 stackable items can be stored on a donkey equipped with a pack saddle. Large items are not supported.

name: Catapult Boulder
description: Catapult Boulder is ammunition that can be fired from the Catapult CatapultIcon.png.

name: Crude Shortbow Arrows
description: Crude Shortbow Arrows are ammunition used by the Crude Shortbow

name: Longbow Arrows
description: Longbow Arrows are ammunition used by the Long Bow

name: Scorpion Arrows
description: Scorpion Arrows are ammunition used by the Scorpion

name: Shortbow Arrows
description: Shortbow Arrows are ammunition used by the Short Bow IconBow.png and the Superior Short Bow IconBow500.png

name: Auxiliary Bowmen Kit
description: Auxiliary Bowmen Kit is an item that can be unbundled to get 10 crude armour sets, 10 Crude Shortbow and 200 Crude Shortbow Arrows.

name: Auxiliary Ration Supply
description: Auxiliary Ration Supply is an item that can be unbundled to get 1000 Auxiliary Rations. Not a edible food source!

name: Auxiliary Rations
description: Auxiliary Rations can be acquired by unbundling Auxiliary Ration Supply . Not a food source, only for Aux Avatar storage!

name: Auxiliary Spearmen Kit
description: Auxiliary Spearmen Kit is an item that can be unbundled to get 10 crude armour sets and 10 Flint Spear.

name: Auxiliary Swordsmen Kit
description: Auxiliary Swordsmen Kit is an item that can be unbundled to get 10 crude armour sets, 10 Crude Short Sword and 10 Crude Shield.

name: Bandage
description: Bandage is a avatar recovery item, allowing wounded avatars to be treated.

name: Barrel
description: A Barrel is a movable storage container designed to compress multiple items into one transportable item, ideal for long-distance transportation via a Caravan , Resource Wagon or Cargo Ship . Items can be packed and unpacked into barrels using the dedicated inventory slot found within a Town Keep , Fortress Keep Homesteads , or Large Camp .

name: Repair Materials
description: Repair Materials are a resource used for repairing damaged structures and vehicles. To use them, equip a hammer and, with repair materials in your inventory, click while facing the target to repair it, restoring a varying percentage of health depending on the target. Repairs cannot be performed if the target is on fire or an enemy is nearby.

name: Silver
description: Silver is the currency of Calligo, used at the Town Marketplace for trading, used for production at TownCraftingTable and as an upkeep cost for the Homesteads and Keeps . Silver can be earned as bounty by exchanging trophies at bounty board.
